description: E2 interface compatibility of the LONRF2 N-module and C-RING placed on the RNF4-UbcH5A frame
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

pdb=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4AP4.pdb",timeout=120).text
rows=[(l[21],l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))
      for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM")]
P=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["ch","aname","res","resi","x","y","z"])
A=P[P.ch=="A"]; E2=P[P.ch=="B"]
RN=[201,204,223,225,228,231]
def af(acc):
    m=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=60).json()[0]
    t=requests.get(m["pdbUrl"],timeout=120).text
    r=[(l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66]))
       for l in t.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM")]
    return pd.DataFrame(r,columns=["aname","res","resi","x","y","z","b"])
Dh=af("Q1L5Z9"); Da=af("H9GDI3"); Dr=af("P78317")
def anchorCA(D,ligs):
    return np.array([D[(D.aname=="CA")&(D.resi==ri+o)][["x","y","z"]].values[0] for ri in ligs for o in (-1,0,1)])
def kab(Pp,Q):
    pm,qm=Pp.mean(0),Q.mean(0);Pc,Qc=Pp-pm,Q-qm
    V,S,W=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc);d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W));R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@W
    return (lambda X:(X-pm)@R+qm), float(np.sqrt((((Pc@R)-Qc)**2).sum(1).mean()))
ref=anchorCA(A,RN)
E2h=E2[~E2.aname.isin(["N","C","O"])][["x","y","z"]].values

Q=[("RNF4 RING\n(control)",Dr,[132,135,154,156,159,162],130,190),
   ("LONRF2\nC-RING",Dh,[449,452,464,466,469,472],440,492),
   ("LONRF2\nN-module",Dh,[143,146,158,160,163,166],134,196),
   ("anole LONRF2\nN-module",Da,[144,147,159,161,164,167],135,190)]
lab=[];con=[];cla=[];nres=[];mind=[]
for nm,D,ligs,lo,hi in Q:
    T,_=kab(anchorCA(D,ligs),ref)
    mod=D[(D.resi>=lo)&(D.resi<=hi)&(~D.aname.isin(["N","C","O"]))]
    X=T(mod[["x","y","z"]].values)
    d=np.sqrt(((X[:,None]-E2h[None])**2).sum(-1))
    lab.append(nm); con.append(int((d<4.5).sum())); cla.append(int((d<2.4).sum()))
    nres.append(len(set(mod.resi.values[np.where((d<4.5).any(1))[0]]))); mind.append(float(d.min()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,4))
c=["#888888","#2b7bba","#d1495b","#e8a33d"]
ax[0].bar(range(4),con,color=c); ax[0].set_ylabel("heavy-atom contacts < 4.5 A with UbcH5A")
ax[0].set_title("E2 contact surface")
ax[1].bar(range(4),cla,color=c); ax[1].set_ylabel("heavy-atom clashes < 2.4 A")
ax[1].set_title("Steric clashes with UbcH5A")
ax[2].bar(range(4),nres,color=c); ax[2].set_ylabel("residues at the E2 interface")
ax[2].set_title("Interface residue count")
for a in ax:
    a.set_xticks(range(4)); a.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); a.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
fig.suptitle("Each module superposed on the E2-engaging RNF4 RING of PDB 4AP4 (18 ligand-anchored Ca atoms),\nthen scored against UbcH5A chain B in place. Fit RMSD 0.19, 0.54, 0.81, 0.71 A.",fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
